release.name: Amethyst
release.author: Izumi
release.description: Modelled on the AniWave site: deep slate surfaces with a soft purple accent and a top bar. The featured swiper shows a slide counter, format and year tags and square-cornered buttons; section titles are small uppercase text; posters have a format tag pinned to the bottom. The watch page docks the player with a scrolling episode list beside it; the series page splits info and an episode rail under underlined tabs. Phones get a flush bottom bar with a dot under the active tab.
